description: Check a font pairing against a built-in table of about 55 common families (Helvetica, Arial, Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, Georgia, Times New Roman, Garamond, Caslon, Jenson, Palatino, Baskerville, Playfair Display, Bodoni, Trade Gothic, Futura, Knockout, Champion Gothic, Oswald, Courier New, JetBrains Mono and others, plus common aliases). Pass `fonts`: two or three names, optionally with a role as "Name:role" (heading, body, code, ui, display, caption; default order is heading, body, code). Returns each face's class (serif, sans, mono, display, script) and structure, how the pair contrasts (same class and structure reads as too similar, serif with sans as clear contrast), x-height and width warnings, role problems (display face for body, high-contrast face at text size, monospace prose), and a verdict: works, works with adjustments, risky or incomplete. A family not in the table is reported as unknown with no verdict for it. Table values are qualitative and approximate. Ideas: Lupton, Thinking with Type (contrast of structure when combining faces); Cullen, Layout Workbook (compare x-height and cap height); Smashing eBooks, Typography Best Practices (short x-height at small sizes).

fonts.description: Two or three font names, optionally "Name:role", for example ["Champion Gothic:heading", "Caslon:body", "Trade Gothic:ui"].
